behaviour: A thin, very salty, deeply savoury liquid drawn from fermented anchovy. It smells strong from the bottle and turns round and meaty in heat. It goes in by the drop, as a salt with more depth.

contains.basis: It is made from fermented anchovy.
Recorded strictly: some are made with shrimp or krill as well.
